m: सुट् (in gram.) a Pratyāhāra used as a technical expression for the first five inflections (i.e. nom. sg. du. pl. acc. sing. du. for masc. and fem. nouns; cf. सर्व-नाम-स्थान).
a: सुट् — A technical term used by Pāṇini for the first five case-inflections; cf. सर्वनामस्थान.

m: सु-टङ्क mfn. (cf. तं-कार) sharp, shrill (said of a disagreeable sound), Bālar. iv, 50/51.
सुट्ट् cl. 10. P. सुट्टयति, to slight, disregard, despise, Dhātup. xxxii, 26; to be small or low or shallow, Vop.; ib.
a: सुट्ट् — {c10c} U. (सुट्टयति-ते) 1 To despise, disregard. --2 To be small, low, or shallow.

s: ka tOcCye । anAdare । iti kavikalpadrumaH (curA॰-para॰-saka॰-sew .) paYcamastarI wadvayAntaH । ka, suwwayati । dantyAdirayamiti BImaH । tOcCyamalpIBAvaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: anAdare cu॰ u॰ saka॰ sew । suwwayati te asusuwwat ta । zopadeSa eva nyAyyaH ।
